name: Load balancer
kid: A traffic warden. Lots of computers could answer, so it picks one that isn’t busy, and sends every parcel of your video to that same one.
nerd: An L4 load balancer holds the service address (VIP). It hashes each connection’s 5-tuple onto a healthy backend (consistent hashing), so every packet of one TCP connection reaches the same server; health checks take broken servers out.
